verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe LiveKit's `TurnDetector` as an audio model that encodes user audio and captures both what is said and how it is said. The docs also say it can predict when a speaker has more to say and wait for them to finish before responding, which is the model-based end-of-turn behavior the story asks for. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the turn detector's real-world accuracy, and documentation detail on configuring it and how it combines with or replaces VAD silence timeouts.
